text:
alex: Kicking off 10% canary to eu-west at 17:00 UTC. Change window until 18:00. Release `v2.4.1`. Quick stop/go?
priya: LGTM on release notes and changelog. :white_check_mark:
jamie: Are healthchecks updated for the new tokenizer path?
morgan: KV cache prewarm done, autoscaler tuning applied per playbook.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting staged rollout: 10% -> eu-west for `v2.4.1` (initiated by alex)
ops-bot: observability snapshot: https://obs.internal/shot/abc123 — watch latency and 5xx panels
nate: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs on edge-eu-west at 17:02 (~0.9%)
alex: holding at 10% for now. if errors >1% sustained for 5m we stop.
sofia: can someone pin fallback version in case we need to abort? I'll prep rollback steps.
priya: creating pin -> pinned `v2.4.0` for eu-west routing (pin id pin-9832)
deploy-bot: [deploybot] rollout paused by alex at 17:03:10
jamie: metrics update: latency +50ms, error rate now 1.6% over 1m window; looking at traces
morgan: digging into infra traces — looks like tokenizer lib 1.9.0 change causes tokenization mismatch on some inputs
alex: decision time — recommend abort and rollback to `v2.4.0` in eu-west. consensus?
priya: agree, aborting. roll back now. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] initiating rollback to `v2.4.0` in eu-west (triggered by alex)
ops-bot: runbook step 3: initiate rollback + increase watch to 10m — posting checklist
nate: errors dropping back toward baseline since rollback started
sofia: filing follow-up issue: ML-1254 tokenizer-lib-1.9.0-incompat; tagging @ml-team @infra
alex: good catch, team. schedule hotfix for next patch train and block tokenizer bump until resolved
priya: confirming traffic now at pre-rollout levels, no further action required from infra
deploy-bot: [deploybot] rollback complete at 17:06:50. Rollout aborted; traffic normalized.
ops-bot: closing watch; keeping incident note in release record
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all — will reopen when we have a patched build and verified benchmarks
priya: adding notes to the release doc and marking `v2.4.1` as failed-canary in release tracker
jamie: follow-up ops postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.
deploy-bot: thread marked resolved.
